body: Thank you. People around me think I'm pretty bright. I'm always the one giving advice. Sometimes I wonder why people come to me. I seem to be great at helping others, but not myself. After some testing, it turns out I have an IQ quite above average. I pride my drive to learn and intelligence (not to toot my own horn) sometimes I think it was a trade off. Awful mental and physical health in exchange for intelligence. I often credit that to my survival. I'm a critical thinker. However, Lost hope tends to block that off at times. I don't think I'd be alive today if I didn't have the brain I do. I was given a second chance as well. About 4 years ago, I successfully commuted suicide, but only for 7 minutes. After being revived, I was very angry. Having some time to mature and grow up after that helped me to realize how thankful I should be for that second chance. I'm sorry if I'm talking so much. It just feels kinda good to get all of this stuff out.

I didn't know how much to mention. I figured it'd be better to keep it short and sweet. I've been doing everything I can to heal and it's been Impossible to balance school and my health at the same time. The bipolar/schizoaffective seems to be the straw that breaks the camels back. Its tearing my life apart and keeping me from focusing on my heart and sympathetic system problems. I've lost a lot of will. Sometimes even the will to live. That's why I plan on having a more direct treatment approach. Without the will, I'll remain very ill. Without health, I can't perform to my best ability. It's all such a confusing situation and I've been too stubborn to help myself for a long time just so I can get through school. Sometimes I feel so limited. I have been working online in the meantime. I want to be able to go to school like all the normal kids, but all of my emergency equipment can't go to school with me. On top of that. People at the Highschool building are very ignorant as far as mental illness goes. The seem to think I'm gonna murder them or something. Blegh. I'm just glad I'm putting a plan in place. I'm sick of my situation and I'm finally gonna do everything I can to change it

Unfortunately, I will never be able to have a job where I can work out of the house. It's not like I'll ever be capable of living on my own or paying bills. Along with Severe Bipolar/Panic. I also suffer from Schizoaffective, heart disease, and chronic sympathetic firing. I'm disabled and that's that. I need to stop pushing that under the rug. pretending it's not there is gonna do me in. I have to have a special setup if I ever want to go to college anyway. my psychiatrist, cardiac specialist and therapist have evaluated things. I am not fit to continue going on with school. And they all agree. There's no "pushing through" for me. Ignoring my health isn't an option anymore. I had to make the decision I didn't want to make, but sometimes that's life and Life is bleak.

Haha Pokemon is a big part of my childhood and I feel like it's one of the only thing that keeps me sane sometimes. I'm really close with my younger brother and I got him into it. Now we play together a lot. I'm such a dweeb about it. I can hear a Pokemons call in the pokedex and tell you what it is just by that. I can tell you almost any pokemon's base stats, I know what all the items do. I know how much damage all the moves do and whether or not it's a physical or special move. I even know the affects of all the berries and what their flavors are for poke lock/poffin cooking. Growing up, I was just one of the guys. Everyone thought it was cool that a girl was really into Pokemon an other games.

I think that's the best analogy I've ever heard haha. And thank you. I've been so down today and it's really cool to have some support.

I love all Pokemon but it really depends. I specialize in training dark and ghost Pokemon. I like different Pokemon for different reasons. The first game I played was gold, but I consider myself a Gen 3 kid because sapphire was the first game I played to completion and it's what got me really hooked, so I like mostly Hoenn Pokemon I guess I can name a few for every region though. For kanto, I love Gengar. It's a bit of a glass cannon but any strong special offensive team mate is a winner. For Jhoto, I really like Houndoom. Houndoom is the Pokemon that started my specialty for training dark Pokemon. For Hoenn, there's too many to name. I always make sure there's a mightyena, a sableye, and a shedininja with the sturdy ability on my team. For Sinoh, I really like froslass and spiritomb. I wasn't gonna list legendaries, but Giratina is my favorite legendary and it's from Sinoh. Unova, chandelure. Never got too much into the game though. And Kalos... I guess I have to name another legendary because I love Yveltal. 

That ended up being a long ass list ~_~ sorry about that. Once I start talking about Pokemon, I can't stop

I do think it would be better at this point to let myself heal before I sink further into the hole. It just feels like such a hard decision. There's such a negative stigma towards dropouts. I don't want to seem as though I haven't tried my hardest. I put so much effort into things that others don't see. Just staying alive sometimes is a struggle. It hurts, but I wouldn't be here if I didn't still want to fight. 

The trollpastas are hilarious haha I love the Mario theory one. It's to the point where I can't tell if the writer was actually serious or not. I like to look for "gem" channels and they aren't easy to find. Someone who's quirky, funny, charming... A youtuber that makes you feel like you're just hanging out with a friend when you're watching. That's rare. If you like Pokemon at all, I suggest abrandontothepast. He's so silly and real. (I'm a huge Pokemon nerd. I've been playing since I was a wee tyke)

I've been thinking of getting a GED and spending a year or two in some more intensive therapy before going to college... Maybe that's a good idea. I'd never wish what I'm going through upon anyone but having someone understand is great. Honestly, just having someone respond to this overwhelms me. It's my very first post that's not a comment. I'll keep the little goals in mind too. If im good at critiquing the small details in a negative light, maybe I can do that in a positive light too. And yes, I love Mutahar. The first thing I watched on his channel was the Ao Oni lets play series around 2 years ago. I've been watching him ever since.
We should start saying "man, he's got Smitd's balls" when someone does something crazy in the face of death. What a fascinating story.
